g_02adce9922da.description: Add a dry_run parameter to Orchestrator.execute_feature in scaffold/agent/orchestrator.py that when True skips the worker LLM call and instead prints what patch it would have generated, useful for previewing agent intent without spending tokens

g_4996f20e5f76.description: Add the 'dry_run: bool = False' parameter to the signature of the 'Orchestrator.execute_feature' method.

tasks.action: Add the 'dry_run: bool = False' parameter to the signature of the 'Orchestrator.execute_feature' method.

g_2249cc5e5efe.description: Inside 'Orchestrator.execute_feature', implement the dry-run logic: wrap the worker LLM call (patch generation) with an 'if not dry_run:' condition. In the 'else' block, print a message indicating the worker LLM call was skipped and a placeholder for the patch that would have been generated (e.g., 'Dry run: Worker LLM would have generated a patch here. Actual content skipped.'), then return an empty string to simulate a successful but empty patch.
